articles.title: Bulgaria summons Russian ambassador after ship sinks in Black Sea drone attack
articles.description: Six crew members are rescued but 10 are missing after a merchant ship was sunk overnight, Bulgaria says.

articles.title: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
articles.description: Despite the US president announcing energy infrastructure would not be targeted strikes have continued, Ukraine says.

articles.title: Is Zelensky right to say data centre strikes have taken down Russian bots?
articles.description: Experts say there is no evidence that Russian trolls have been affected by Ukraine’s Yandex attacks.

articles.title: Adult victims of arson attack which also killed two children are named
articles.description: Two adults who died alongside two children following an arson attack at a home in Ireland have been named as Philip and Kim English.

articles.title: French supermarket fridges heated to 50C in cyber attack - causing fires and food losses
articles.description: Hackers carried out a cyber attack on hundreds of French supermarkets overnight - pushing temperatures in fridges up to 50C and sparking fires.

articles.title: Nobel Peace Prize winner criticises Trump over 'negative and cruel' attacks
articles.description: This year's winner of the Nobel Peace Prize has criticised Donald Trump for his attacks on the International Criminal Court, calling them "completely unlawful" as well as "negative and cruel".
